expected_output_baseline_method: For each of the four already-admitted provisions, ran scripts/offline_importer.py's current extraction (pdftotext_layout / extract_pdf_range for PDF representations, html_section_to_text for the structured-HTML representation) against the exact retained source bytes already bound by that provision's review record (source_representation.sha256, and pdf_anchor.sha256 for section 6), using the same PDF page ranges and section boundaries that review record already declares. Computed sha256 over the resulting body text and, where applicable, footnote text. Confirmed each result was consistent with the wording that record's own review.scope and evidence already describe (clause markers, provisos, amendment brackets, footnote text) by re-reading the same retained page renders that review record cites, plus (for section 8) the newly regenerated page-10 render. Recorded the resulting digests as expected_output on each review record. This is a fidelity/consistency check between the current pipeline's output and the original review's described scope, not a new independent legal review, and not a claim that these digests existed at the time of the original review -- they did not.
